# InvalidLicenseTierError

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Thrown when `settings.license` is assigned a value outside the `import` union — a typo in the consumer's startup code (`'comunity'`), not an undeclared licence.

Distinct from [`BonniePdfLicenseError`](bonnie-pdf-license-error.md) on purpose: this one throws in every environment, immediately, because it is a programming error rather than a licensing state, and no amount of production-safety reasoning makes silently ignoring it correct.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `Error`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new InvalidLicenseTierError(message: string)
```
